# System overview

## Areas

| Area | Summary | Doc |
|---|---|---|
| Approvals and human proof | Makes sure approvals and level changes come from the user, not the model, across the CLI proof check and the mod's menu and guards. | [approvals](system/approvals.md) |
| Build, release and project docs | The committed bundle, the plugin manifests and version, package tooling, and the repo's own docs. | [build-and-release](system/build-and-release.md) |
| Evidence, drift and follow-ups | Records check, review and on-track results, flags out-of-scope edits, and keeps follow-ups bounded. | [evidence-and-follow-ups](system/evidence-and-follow-ups.md) |
| Live pane | The mod's interface: the pane, agent cards, the status bar, usage and cost, and pause and resume. | [live-pane](system/live-pane.md) |
| Plan location and branches | Finds the plan from the git branch and worktree, names plan folders and branches, and migrates old layouts. | [plan-location](system/plan-location.md) |
| Plan state and stage checks | Plan state, who may write it, and the checks for moving between stages. | [plan-state](system/plan-state.md) |
| Procedures, skills and agents | The markdown that tells agents what to do at each stage, and the doc tests that pin its wording. | [procedures](system/procedures.md) |
| Project memory | Area docs, the repo-wide decision log, recall, the session index and the overview, plus the close-time check that keeps area docs current. | [project-memory](system/project-memory.md) |
| Plan loading and parallel tasks | Reads the task list from plan.md into state and decides which tasks can run at once. | [tasks](system/tasks.md) |

## Decisions in force

| Decision | Areas | Plan | Date |
|---|---|---|---|
| [2026-10-20-how-do-cairn-s-git-calls](decisions/2026-10-20-how-do-cairn-s-git-calls.md) Every CLI git call runs with gc.auto=0 and maintenance.auto=false. | plan-location | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-how-do-pause-and-resume-work](decisions/2026-10-20-how-do-pause-and-resume-work.md) Pause is instant: the mod writes handoff.md and runs cairn pause, even mid-turn. Resume continues in place inside the cache window; after that the user runs /clear then /cairn:resume, which loads only state, handoff and status. | live-pane, plan-state | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-how-does-the-fix-fast-lane](decisions/2026-10-20-how-does-the-fix-fast-lane.md) Fix plans run repro, execute, review, ship, closed; the repro must fail when recorded and pass before done, and a fix over fixMaxFiles (default 8) refuses and offers cairn escalate. Fix plans get the five-axis review. | plan-location, plan-state | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-how-is-a-human-approval-proven](decisions/2026-10-20-how-is-a-human-approval-proven.md) The mod watches the tagged approval menu and runs cairn approve with a one-time secret; without the mod, --human works only at a real terminal with the typed plan name. The model cannot approve, override, or write plan state. | approvals | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-how-is-the-mod-s-session](decisions/2026-10-20-how-is-the-mod-s-session.md) register.tsx registers one session.start fan-out that calls each module in order. | live-pane | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-how-is-the-on-track-verdict](decisions/2026-10-20-how-is-the-on-track-verdict.md) The CLI computes green, yellow or red from a fixed cairn-direction scorecard; red blocks phase approval, yellow can be approved, and a re-plan or later code commit invalidates the verdict. | evidence-and-follow-ups | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-where-does-the-approval-secret-live](decisions/2026-10-20-where-does-the-approval-secret-live.md) Only its SHA-256 hash is on disk; the mod holds the secret in memory and rotates it, the CLI spends it once, there are no grant files, and child commands run with it stripped from their environment. | approvals | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-where-does-the-orchestrating-session-run](decisions/2026-10-20-where-does-the-orchestrating-session-run.md) At the repo root, not locked into a worktree, running cd <plan worktree> && cairn …; subagents edit and commit in task worktrees. | procedures | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-20-which-menu-answers-count-as-an](decisions/2026-10-20-which-menu-answers-count-as-an.md) Only an answer to the question tagged for this plan and stop, while the CLI reports that stop ready, with a label that reads as approving; a Revise-then-Approve is recorded. | approvals | cairn-v0-2 | 2026-10-20 |
| [2026-10-21-does-a-plan-close-before-or](decisions/2026-10-21-does-a-plan-close-before-or.md) Close first, merge last, so every record lands on main; until the branch is merged, status shows Closed · PR open, detected from the gh PR state or local ancestry. | plan-state, plan-location | sharper-interview-and-review | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-how-are-follow-ups-and-findings](decisions/2026-10-21-how-are-follow-ups-and-findings.md) At most 5 open follow-ups per plan, expiring after 2 declines or 60 days; the recorder writes the record's Findings from the plan log, learn asks nothing, and close requires Findings. | evidence-and-follow-ups, project-memory | cleaner-pane-and-records | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-how-are-plan-and-task-branches](decisions/2026-10-21-how-are-plan-and-task-branches.md) Plans use feature/<slug> or fix/<slug>, tasks use task/<slug>/<task>, worktree folders are the branch with / as -, only a plan's recorded branch counts as the plan, and legacy sdlc/ branches still resolve. | plan-location | standard-branch-names | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-how-are-plan-folders-named-and](decisions/2026-10-21-how-are-plan-folders-named-and.md) Plan folders are <local-date>-<slug> under docs/cairn/plans; lookup prefers the dated folder, falls back to the undated one, and resolves through the main checkout. | plan-location | cleaner-pane-and-records | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-how-are-review-findings-labelled-and](decisions/2026-10-21-how-are-review-findings-labelled-and.md) Critical and Required are fixed before merge, Optional and Nit become follow-ups; every task gets a five-axis review and risky tasks also get the security reviewer. | procedures, evidence-and-follow-ups | sharper-interview-and-review | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-how-do-late-stage-status-words](decisions/2026-10-21-how-do-late-stage-status-words.md) The CLI records the current check, review or ship step with cairn step, cleared on advance, and status JSON carries the wording every surface renders. | plan-state, live-pane | pane-status-bar-and-polish | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-how-does-the-discover-interview-run](decisions/2026-10-21-how-does-the-discover-interview-run.md) Guess and confidence, goal questions one at a time, implications, decisions, then a read-back card that needs an explicit yes; choices are multiple choice with the guess first. | procedures | sharper-interview-and-review | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-how-is-the-pane-laid-out](decisions/2026-10-21-how-is-the-pane-laid-out.md) Three tabs (Now, History, Records) and a bottom-pinned bar; Now shows fixed-height clickable cards with the main session first; the pane polls state every 2 seconds and works inline at 48 columns. | live-pane | cleaner-pane-and-records | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-should-the-pane-set-a-transparent](decisions/2026-10-21-should-the-pane-set-a-transparent.md) No. Claude Code paints the docked pane, so the mod sets no backgroundColor; don't retry it. | live-pane | sharper-interview-and-review | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-what-does-the-pane-s-spend](decisions/2026-10-21-what-does-the-pane-s-spend.md) This plan's cost and tokens in this session only, reset on restart; agent cards show ~$ estimates from a built-in price table; spend is never persisted, capped, or written to the record. | live-pane | pane-status-bar-and-polish | 2026-10-21 |
| [2026-10-21-when-does-the-pane-show-the](decisions/2026-10-21-when-does-the-pane-show-the.md) Only when cairn status reports the stop ready; the card summarizes what is being approved with Read all, and approving there answers the open chat question early. | approvals, live-pane | standard-branch-names | 2026-10-21 |

None yet.

## Plans

- 2026-10-21 **Cleaner pane and records**: The pane was hard to read: cards changed height on every tool call, and a follow-up count nobody could act on kept growing. [record](plans/2026-10-21-cleaner-pane-and-records/RECORD.md)
- 2026-10-21 **Pane status bar and polish**: The pane said "all phases done" while review was still running, hid spend and usage limits, ignored clicks on agent cards, and could not scroll to the end of long documents. [record](../sdlc/plans/2026-10-21-pane-status-bar-and-polish/RECORD.md)
- 2026-10-21 **Roomier pane visuals**: The cairn pane was hard to scan: text sat flush against the left edge, tabs stacked lines with no gaps, and the body was drawn black. [record](../sdlc/plans/2026-10-21-roomier-pane-visuals/RECORD.md)
- 2026-10-21 **Sharper interview and review**: cairn's interview never asked what a build was for, review looked only at risky tasks and said little about readability or architecture, and security showed up only at review time. [record](../sdlc/plans/2026-10-21-sharper-interview-and-review/RECORD.md)
- 2026-10-21 **Standard branch names**: cairn named its branches `sdlc/<slug>` and `sdlc-task/<slug>/<task>`, which read as tool plumbing in a branch list or PR. [record](plans/2026-10-21-standard-branch-names/RECORD.md)
- 2026-10-20 **cairn v0.2**: In cairn v0.1 the model relayed approvals itself, and plan state was visible only on request. [record](plans/2026-10-20-cairn-v0-2/RECORD.md)
